units: metres; design decisions, not dimensions measured from reference
scope: Exterior Lv1-5 same shape/material/details; uniform scale only, as Barn precedent

coordinates.unity: X right; Y up; Z rear; front -Z; origin ground centre
coordinates.blender: X right; Y rear; Z up; front -Y; apply transforms before export

detailRules.roofMethod: subdivided planes and low-poly row lips, no solid tile per shingle
detailRules.wireMethod: sparse flat diamond lattice behind half shutter, not dense hex tubes or new alpha texture
detailRules.rear: one gable louver, no rear door

budget.note: planning allowance, not measured final mesh count; final bevel/hidden-face removal must be audited

integration.lodCreation: Build authored simplifications in Blender; Unity LODGroup selects them, does not generate their mesh geometry
integration.chickenHatch: decorative closed exterior in this scope; animal travel remains separate runtime concern
integration.gridRule: ceil(world width or depth / actual FieldArea.CellSize)
integration.level5Balance: not specified: no invented price, days, capacity or interior changes
integration.placementRootRule: root = reservation anchor - yaw-rotated reservation-center offset

reference.leftRear: explicit proposal: left one central window, rear gable vent; same cream panels and foundation
